notes: Change (CEO: "the cards can just be flat ... 3 colors primary secondary and accent. Icons get secondary. Font family will be choosable ... give it a new name"; then "card options: color / opacity / border (all settings). Background…
Font: family (Inter, Poppins, Jost, Kanit, Saira, Exo 2); primary colour for numbers and words; secondary colour for the icons.
Accent: the dials and what is lit.
Cards: colour, opacity, border width, border colour, border opacity and corners.
Background: an image, plus a colour and opacity over it (at lower opacity the image or the desktop shows).
